prompt:
The file sections/contact-form-fields.liquid contains a finished contact form section. Its markup loops over the section's blocks and carries state across iterations:
- a running field_index numbers each field id;
- a required_count decides whether a required-fields note is shown;
- an email_rendered flag ensures that only the first email block is posted as contact[email].

The markup is correct and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. The schema is incomplete. Replace the JSON inside the single top-level {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block so it is exactly the following, keeping keys and array entries in the order given.

Top-level keys, in order:
- name: "Contact form"
- tag: "section"
- class: "section-contact-form"
- settings, blocks, max_blocks, presets (described below)

settings (in this order; keys type, id, label, default):
1. text "heading", label "Heading", default "Contact us"
2. text "submit_label", label "Submit button label", default "Send"
3. checkbox "show_required_note", label "Show required fields note", default true
4. text "required_note", label "Required fields note", default "* Required fields"

The width setting (W), used by every block: select, id "width", label "Field width", options full/"Full" then half/"Half" (value/label), default "full". Use keys in the order type, id, label, options, default.

blocks (in this order; keys type, name, limit if any, settings). Each block's settings are, in order:
- a text setting "label", label "Label", with the block-specific default below;
- a checkbox "required", label "Required", with the block-specific default below;
- W.

The blocks:
1. type "text", name "Text field", no limit. label default "Name"; required default false.
2. type "email", name "Email field", limit 2. label default "Email"; required default true.
3. type "phone", name "Phone field", limit 1. label default "Phone number"; required default false.
4. type "textarea", name "Message field", limit 1. label default "Message"; required default false. After W, add a range setting: id "rows", label "Rows", min 3, max 10, step 1, default 5 (keys type, id, label, min, max, step, default; no unit).
5. type "checkbox", name "Checkbox", no limit. label default "I agree to receive marketing emails"; required default false.

max_blocks: 12.

presets: exactly one preset, name "Contact form". Its blocks, in order, are text, email and textarea. Each preset block has only a type key.

Do not add any other keys. Change only sections/contact-form-fields.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
